==> quadlet/roostack-forgejo-db-main.container
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=Roostack forgejo: database main (postgres)

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-forgejo-db-main
Image=docker.io/library/postgres:17-alpine@sha256:b0f9560a2de083e2cc7382e75f808c7381a32852a7ec49117deedb300e552b24
Network=roostack-forgejo.network
Environment=POSTGRES_USER=forgejo
Environment=POSTGRES_DB=forgejo
Environment=POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/db-password
Secret=roostack-forgejo-db-main-password,type=mount,target=db-password
Volume=/srv/roostack/services/forgejo/db/main:/var/lib/postgresql/data
HealthCmd=pg_isready -U forgejo -d forgejo
HealthInterval=10s
HealthStartPeriod=30s
Notify=healthy
Label=io.roostack.service=forgejo
Label=io.roostack.component=db-main

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> quadlet/roostack-forgejo-app.container
# Generated by Roostack. Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

[Unit]
Description=Roostack forgejo: app
Requires=roostack-forgejo-db-main.service
After=roostack-forgejo-db-main.service

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-forgejo-app
Image=codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo:15.0.9-rootless@sha256:caf1bca332f95cdcf124227a4bfa3b49bbbfbbc8a5e4a97406921cb581165413
Network=roostack-forgejo.network
PublishPort=127.0.0.1:20020:3000
Environment=FORGEJO__database__DB_TYPE=postgres
Environment=FORGEJO__database__HOST=roostack-forgejo-db-main:5432
Environment=FORGEJO__database__NAME=forgejo
Environment=FORGEJO__database__USER=forgejo
Environment=FORGEJO__oauth2_client__ACCOUNT_LINKING=auto
Environment=FORGEJO__oauth2_client__ENABLE_AUTO_REGISTRATION=true
Environment=FORGEJO__oauth2_client__USERNAME=nickname
Environment=FORGEJO__security__INSTALL_LOCK=true
Environment=FORGEJO__server__DISABLE_SSH=true
Environment=FORGEJO__server__ROOT_URL=https://git.lab.example.com/
Environment=FORGEJO__server__SSH_DOMAIN=git.lab.example.com
Environment=FORGEJO__server__SSH_LISTEN_PORT=2222
Environment=FORGEJO__server__SSH_PORT=2222
Environment=FORGEJO__server__START_SSH_SERVER=true
Environment=FORGEJO__service__ALLOW_ONLY_EXTERNAL_REGISTRATION=true
Environment=FORGEJO__service__DISABLE_REGISTRATION=false
Environment=GITEA_APP_INI=/var/lib/gitea/custom/conf/app.ini
Secret=roostack-forgejo-db-main-password,type=env,target=FORGEJO__database__PASSWD
AddHost=login.lab.example.com:host-gateway
Volume=/srv/roostack/services/forgejo/data:/var/lib/gitea
Label=io.roostack.service=forgejo
Label=io.roostack.component=app
UserNS=keep-id:uid=1000,gid=1000

[Service]
Restart=always
TimeoutStartSec=900

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

==> caddy/sites/forgejo.caddy
# Generated by Roostack for service "forgejo". Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

@forgejo-web host git.lab.example.com
handle @forgejo-web {
	vars {
		roostack_name forgejo
		roostack_title "Forgejo"
		roostack_private yes
	}
	@forgejo-web-external not {
		remote_ip private_ranges 100.64.0.0/12 100.80.0.0/16 100.82.0.0/15 100.84.0.0/14 100.88.0.0/13 100.96.128.0/17 100.97.0.0/16 100.98.0.0/15 100.104.0.0/13 100.112.0.0/12
		not vars roostack_edge yes
	}
	abort @forgejo-web-external
	request_body {
		max_size 1GB
	}
	request_header -Remote-User
	request_header -Remote-Email
	request_header -Remote-Name
	request_header -Remote-Groups
	reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:20020
}
